statement_map.email_excerpt: You wanted to find out why new leads from your funnel form had stopped reaching your CRM.
We found a typo in your webhook URL, you corrected and saved it, and your test lead now shows up in your CRM.
The leads stopped because our engineer Karan broke the webhook retries in the last deploy, and your legacy plan account is flagged in our tracker as FF-INT-4821.
We will use Zephyr Console to re-index the webhook queue, have our technical team resend the missed leads to your CRM, and message you once that is done.
